Field Definition: Unique identifier for the payment transaction (Base32 encoded Charge ID)
AI Summary: The unique ID for this payment — use this to look up or reference the transaction.

Field Definition: Text that appears on the cardholder's bank statement identifying the merchant
AI Summary: The name the cardholder will see on their bank statement for this payment.

Field Definition: The channel or configuration used to process this payment
AI Summary: The merchant configuration used to route and process this payment.

Field Definition: Timestamp when the payment was created
AI Summary: When this payment was created in the Checkout.com system.

Field Definition: The type of event recorded in the payment lifecycle
Value Definition: The issuer has approved and ring-fenced the payment amount. Funds are not yet captured.
AI Summary: The payment was authorised — funds are held but not yet taken from the cardholder.

Field Definition: The type of event recorded in the payment lifecycle
Value Definition: The merchant has requested the previously authorised funds to be settled. Can be full or partial.
AI Summary: The merchant has requested the funds — the cardholder will be charged.

Field Definition: The type of event recorded in the payment lifecycle
Value Definition: A capture for less than the originally authorised amount.
AI Summary: The merchant captured only part of the authorised amount — the remainder was released.

Field Definition: The type of event recorded in the payment lifecycle
Value Definition: Funds are returned to the cardholder following a previous capture. Can be full or partial.
AI Summary: A refund was issued to the cardholder against a previous charge.

Field Definition: The type of event recorded in the payment lifecycle
Value Definition: The authorisation is cancelled before capture. Releases the ring-fenced funds.
AI Summary: The authorisation was cancelled before the merchant took the funds — the cardholder was not charged.

Field Definition: The type of event recorded in the payment lifecycle
Value Definition: A zero-value authorisation used to verify card details without charging the cardholder.
AI Summary: The card was verified without any charge being made.

Field Definition: The type of event recorded in the payment lifecycle
Value Definition: Funds pushed directly to a card (e.g. winnings or disbursements). Not linked to a prior payment.
AI Summary: Funds were sent to the cardholder's card — this is not a refund but a standalone payment out.

Field Definition: The type of event recorded in the payment lifecycle
Value Definition: Funds returned to the cardholder outside the standard refund flow.
AI Summary: Funds were returned to the cardholder outside the standard refund process.

Field Definition: The type of event recorded in the payment lifecycle
Value Definition: A dispute-initiated reversal of a captured payment raised by the cardholder's bank.
AI Summary: The cardholder's bank has reversed this payment as part of a dispute.

Field Definition: The type of event recorded in the payment lifecycle
Value Definition: The fraud engine evaluated the transaction before authorisation and accepted it as low risk.
AI Summary: The fraud engine reviewed this payment before authorisation and passed it as low risk.

Field Definition: The type of event recorded in the payment lifecycle
Value Definition: The fraud engine evaluated the transaction before authorisation and declined it as high risk.
AI Summary: The fraud engine blocked this payment before authorisation due to high risk signals.

Field Definition: The type of event recorded in the payment lifecycle
Value Definition: The fraud engine evaluated the transaction after authorisation and approved it for capture.
AI Summary: The fraud engine reviewed this payment after authorisation and cleared it for capture.

Field Definition: The type of event recorded in the payment lifecycle
Value Definition: The 3D Secure authentication step completed successfully.
AI Summary: The cardholder passed 3D Secure authentication successfully.

Field Definition: The type of event recorded in the payment lifecycle
Value Definition: A 3D Secure authentication request was initiated.
AI Summary: A 3D Secure authentication challenge was sent to the cardholder.

Field Definition: The type of event recorded in the payment lifecycle
Value Definition: The payment request has been successfully initiated and is awaiting customer action or bank processing. Common for redirect-based APMs (iDEAL / Sofort / Bancontact) and direct debit methods (SEPA / ACH).
AI Summary: The payment is in progress — waiting for the customer to complete their action or the bank to respond.

Field Definition: The type of event recorded in the payment lifecycle
Value Definition: The customer has approved the payment (e.g. completed the bank redirect) and the capture request has been sent to the bank or partner. Awaiting confirmation.
AI Summary: The customer approved the payment and funds are being collected — confirmation is pending.

Field Definition: The type of event recorded in the payment lifecycle
Value Definition: The payment has been approved by the customer (e.g. on the APM's checkout page). Applies to BNPL methods (Klarna / PayPal) where manual capture is enabled.
AI Summary: The customer approved this payment — the merchant still needs to capture the funds.

Field Definition: The type of event recorded in the payment lifecycle
Value Definition: The BNPL partner (e.g. Klarna) has pre-assessed and approved the payment context before the customer completes checkout.
AI Summary: The BNPL provider has pre-approved this transaction — the customer still needs to complete checkout.

Field Definition: The type of event recorded in the payment lifecycle
Value Definition: The customer cancelled the payment during the redirect or APM checkout flow before completion.
AI Summary: The customer cancelled this payment before completing it.

Field Definition: The type of event recorded in the payment lifecycle
Value Definition: The payment reached its expiry time without being completed or captured. Applies to redirect APMs (e.g. Sofort expires after 2 hours) and BNPL methods.
AI Summary: This payment expired before the customer completed it or the merchant captured it — no charge was made.

Field Definition: The type of event recorded in the payment lifecycle
Value Definition: A previously captured direct debit payment has been reversed after settlement. Applies to SEPA and ACH. Three variants: post-settlement return (up to 5 days); authorised refund (up to 8 weeks); unauthorised dispute (up to 13 months).
AI Summary: This direct debit payment was reversed after it had already been collected — funds have been returned to the customer.

Field Definition: The type of event recorded in the payment lifecycle
Value Definition: The payment authorisation was cancelled after approval but before or after partial capture. Applies to BNPL methods (Klarna / PayPal) with manual capture enabled.
AI Summary: The payment was voided after approval — the customer will not be charged for the remaining amount.

Field Definition: The type of event recorded in the payment lifecycle
Value Definition: The capture request was rejected by the bank or APM partner after the customer approved the payment.
AI Summary: The attempt to collect funds failed after the customer approved — the payment was not completed.

Field Definition: The type of event recorded in the payment lifecycle
Value Definition: The refund request has been successfully initiated and is being processed by the bank or APM partner.
AI Summary: A refund has been requested and is being processed — it has not yet been confirmed.

Field Definition: The type of event recorded in the payment lifecycle
Value Definition: The refund request was rejected by the bank or APM partner.
AI Summary: The refund attempt was rejected — the funds have not been returned to the customer.

Field Definition: The type of event recorded in the payment lifecycle
Value Definition: The void request was rejected by the APM partner. Applies to BNPL methods with manual capture enabled.
AI Summary: The attempt to void this payment was rejected — the payment remains active.

Field Definition: Timestamp when a specific payment action was processed by Checkout.com (distinct from Requested on which reflects when the merchant submitted the request)
AI Summary: When this specific action — for example a capture or refund — was processed.

Field Definition: Unique identifier for a specific action within the payment timeline
AI Summary: The unique ID for this specific event on the payment timeline.

Field Definition: The monetary value associated with the timeline action
AI Summary: The amount involved in this specific payment event.

Field Definition: Internal response code associated with the action (e.g. 20156 = Transaction type not supported)
AI Summary: An internal code providing additional detail on this event — cross-reference with the response code list for the full meaning.

Field Definition: The reason code or description returned for this action by the acquirer or scheme
AI Summary: The reason provided by the acquirer or scheme for this outcome.

Field Definition: Code returned by the issuer confirming the authorisation. Typically a 6-character alphanumeric code.
AI Summary: The issuer's confirmation code for this authorisation — used for reference in disputes or proof of payment.

Field Definition: Merchant or acquirer reference associated with the action
AI Summary: The reference number assigned by the merchant or acquirer to this specific event.

Field Definition: Unique reference assigned by the acquirer to the transaction (also known as ARN). Used for dispute and chargeback tracking with the scheme. Distinct from the Retrieval Reference Number (RRN) which is scheme-assigned for retrieval requests.
AI Summary: The ARN is the key reference for tracking this transaction with the card scheme — essential for chargeback and dispute investigations.

Field Definition: Name of the cardholder as stored on the card
AI Summary: The name on the card used for this payment.

Field Definition: Masked primary account number (PAN) of the card used. Displayed as first 6 (BIN) and last 4 digits.
AI Summary: The card number used — only the first 6 (BIN) and last 4 digits are shown for security.

Field Definition: Indicates whether a network token (VTS or MDES) is available for this card
Value Definition: A network token exists for this card from Visa Token Service (VTS) or Mastercard Digital Enablement Service (MDES). Reduces fraud risk and improves authorisation rates.
AI Summary: A network token is available for this card — this can improve authorisation rates and reduce fraud risk.

Field Definition: Indicates whether a network token (VTS or MDES) is available for this card
Value Definition: No network token is available for this card.
AI Summary: No network token is available for this card — it was charged using the raw card details.

Field Definition: The payment method used to initiate the payment. For card payments this is the card scheme (e.g. Visa / Mastercard). For alternative payment methods this is the APM name (e.g. Klarna / iDEAL / PayPal).
Value Definition: Card payment via the Visa scheme.
AI Summary: The cardholder paid by Visa card.

Field Definition: The payment method used to initiate the payment. For card payments this is the card scheme (e.g. Visa / Mastercard). For alternative payment methods this is the APM name (e.g. Klarna / iDEAL / PayPal).

Value Definition: Payment made via Klarna BNPL.

Field Definition: The payment method used to initiate the payment. For card payments this is the card scheme (e.g. Visa / Mastercard). For alternative payment methods this is the APM name (e.g. Klarna / iDEAL / PayPal).

Field Definition: The payment method used to initiate the payment. For card payments this is the card scheme (e.g. Visa / Mastercard). For alternative payment methods this is the APM name (e.g. Klarna / iDEAL / PayPal).

Field Definition: The payment method used to initiate the payment. For card payments this is the card scheme (e.g. Visa / Mastercard). For alternative payment methods this is the APM name (e.g. Klarna / iDEAL / PayPal).
Value Definition: Payment made via Sofort (European bank transfer).

Field Definition: The payment method used to initiate the payment. For card payments this is the card scheme (e.g. Visa / Mastercard). For alternative payment methods this is the APM name (e.g. Klarna / iDEAL / PayPal).

Field Definition: The payment method used to initiate the payment. For card payments this is the card scheme (e.g. Visa / Mastercard). For alternative payment methods this is the APM name (e.g. Klarna / iDEAL / PayPal).
Value Definition: Payment collected via SEPA Direct Debit.

Field Definition: The payment method used to initiate the payment. For card payments this is the card scheme (e.g. Visa / Mastercard). For alternative payment methods this is the APM name (e.g. Klarna / iDEAL / PayPal).
Value Definition: Payment collected via ACH Direct Debit (US).
AI Summary: The customer paid via ACH Direct Debit — a US bank debit method.

Field Definition: The card network used for acquiring this transaction. Distinct from Payment method (what the customer chose) and Local scheme (domestic overlay). Reflects the scheme under which settlement and dispute rules apply.

Field Definition: The card network used for acquiring this transaction. Distinct from Payment method (what the customer chose) and Local scheme (domestic overlay). Reflects the scheme under which settlement and dispute rules apply.

Field Definition: The card network used for acquiring this transaction. Distinct from Payment method (what the customer chose) and Local scheme (domestic overlay). Reflects the scheme under which settlement and dispute rules apply.
Value Definition: Acquired under the Diners Club International scheme.
AI Summary: This transaction was acquired and settled under the Diners Club International scheme rules.

Field Definition: The card network used for acquiring this transaction. Distinct from Payment method (what the customer chose) and Local scheme (domestic overlay). Reflects the scheme under which settlement and dispute rules apply.
Value Definition: Acquired under the Discover scheme.
AI Summary: This transaction was acquired and settled under the Discover scheme rules.

Field Definition: The card network used for acquiring this transaction. Distinct from Payment method (what the customer chose) and Local scheme (domestic overlay). Reflects the scheme under which settlement and dispute rules apply.
Value Definition: Acquired under the JCB scheme.
AI Summary: This transaction was acquired and settled under the JCB scheme rules.

Field Definition: Acquirer-assigned transaction ID for this specific action. Distinct from the Acquirer reference number (ARN) — the ARN is the overall transaction reference; this ID is assigned per action by the acquirer.
AI Summary: The acquirer's own ID for this action — used alongside the ARN for acquirer-level investigation.

Field Definition: Human-readable name of the processing channel used for this action. Corresponds to the Processing channel ID shown in the payment header.
AI Summary: The name of the processing channel used — a readable label for the channel configuration.

Field Definition: The expiry date of the card used in MM/YYYY format
AI Summary: The expiry date of the card used for this payment.

Field Definition: Two-letter ISO country code of the country where the card was issued
AI Summary: The country where the card was issued — may differ from the cardholder's location.

Field Definition: Name of the bank that issued the card to the cardholder
AI Summary: The bank that issued the card — relevant for understanding issuer-side declines.

Field Definition: Result of the card verification value (CVV) check returned by the issuer
Value Definition: The CVV provided by the cardholder matched the value held by the issuer.
AI Summary: The CVV was correct — the security code matched the issuer's record.

Field Definition: Result of the card verification value (CVV) check returned by the issuer
Value Definition: The CVV provided did not match the issuer's record.
AI Summary: The CVV provided did not match — the security code was incorrect.

Field Definition: Result of the card verification value (CVV) check returned by the issuer
Value Definition: The CVV should be on the card but the merchant indicated it was not present.
AI Summary: The CVV was not provided by the merchant even though it should be on the card.

Field Definition: Result of the card verification value (CVV) check returned by the issuer
Value Definition: The CVV check was not performed for this transaction.
AI Summary: No CVV check was run on this transaction.

Field Definition: Result of the card verification value (CVV) check returned by the issuer
Field Value: U - Issuer does not support CVV
Value Definition: The card-issuing bank does not support CVV verification.
AI Summary: The issuing bank does not support CVV checks — this is expected for some issuers.

Field Definition: Result of the card verification value (CVV) check returned by the issuer
Value Definition: CVV information is not available for this transaction.
AI Summary: CVV information was unavailable for this transaction.

Field Definition: Classification of the payment as required by the card scheme
Value Definition: A standard card-present or card-not-present e-commerce payment.
AI Summary: This is a standard one-off payment.

Field Definition: Classification of the payment as required by the card scheme
Value Definition: Mail Order / Telephone Order — cardholder details provided by phone or post rather than via an online session.
AI Summary: The card details were provided by phone or post — not entered online by the cardholder.

Field Definition: Classification of the payment as required by the card scheme
Value Definition: A repeat charge using stored card details under a recurring billing agreement.
AI Summary: This is a recurring charge — the cardholder's card is billed automatically on a schedule.

Field Definition: Classification of the payment as required by the card scheme
Value Definition: A payment split into multiple scheduled charges under an instalment agreement.
AI Summary: This is one instalment in a series of scheduled charges.

Field Definition: Classification of the payment as required by the card scheme
Value Definition: An Account Funding Transaction (AFT) — funds pushed to a card not linked to a prior purchase (e.g. wallet top-up or P2P transfer).
AI Summary: This is a funds transfer to a card — not a purchase. Common for wallet top-ups or P2P transfers.

Field Definition: The funding type of the card used
Value Definition: Funds are drawn from a credit line extended by the issuer.
AI Summary: The cardholder paid with a credit card — funds are drawn from a credit line.

Field Definition: The funding type of the card used
Value Definition: Funds are drawn directly from the cardholder's bank account.
AI Summary: The cardholder paid with a debit card — funds come directly from their bank account.

Field Definition: The funding type of the card used
Value Definition: Funds are drawn from a pre-loaded balance on the card.
AI Summary: The cardholder paid with a prepaid card — funds come from a pre-loaded balance.

Field Definition: A unique identifier derived from card details (SHA256 hash of PAN + expiry) used to track the same card across multiple transactions
AI Summary: A unique identifier for this specific card — use it to identify if the same card has been used in other transactions.

Field Definition: Indicates whether the transaction is an Account Funding Transaction — a payout to a card not linked to a prior purchase
Value Definition: This is an Account Funding Transaction. Funds are pushed to the card (e.g. for wallet loading or P2P transfer). Not necessarily linked to a prior payment.
AI Summary: This is an Account Funding Transaction — funds are being sent to the card rather than collected from it.

Field Definition: Indicates whether the transaction is an Account Funding Transaction — a payout to a card not linked to a prior purchase
Value Definition: This is a standard payment transaction.
AI Summary: This is a standard payment — not an Account Funding Transaction.

Field Definition: The 3DS authentication flow used for this transaction
Value Definition: 3D Secure authentication was used. Includes both frictionless and challenge flows.
AI Summary: 3D Secure authentication was used for this payment.

Field Definition: The 3DS authentication flow used for this transaction
Value Definition: The issuer authenticated the cardholder passively using risk-based data signals with no cardholder interaction required.
AI Summary: The cardholder was authenticated silently in the background — no action was required from them.

Field Definition: The 3DS authentication flow used for this transaction
Value Definition: The issuer required active cardholder verification (e.g. OTP or biometric) as part of authentication.
AI Summary: The cardholder was asked to actively verify their identity — for example via a one-time passcode.

Field Definition: The 3DS authentication flow used for this transaction
Value Definition: Authentication occurred independently from the cardholder's payment session (e.g. via a banking app notification).
AI Summary: The cardholder authenticated separately from the checkout — for example via a notification in their banking app.

Field Definition: Unique identifier for the 3DS authentication transaction
AI Summary: The unique ID for the 3DS authentication event linked to this payment.

Field Definition: The outcome of the 3DS authentication request returned by the Access Control Server (ACS)
Value Definition: Authentication successful — the cardholder was verified.
AI Summary: The cardholder was successfully authenticated.

Field Definition: The outcome of the 3DS authentication request returned by the Access Control Server (ACS)
Value Definition: Authentication failed — the cardholder was not authenticated. Transaction denied.
AI Summary: Authentication failed — the cardholder could not be verified and the transaction was denied.

Field Definition: The outcome of the 3DS authentication request returned by the Access Control Server (ACS)
Value Definition: Authentication unavailable — the issuer or ACS could not complete the authentication.
AI Summary: Authentication could not be completed — the issuer or authentication system was unavailable.

Field Definition: The outcome of the 3DS authentication request returned by the Access Control Server (ACS)
Value Definition: Authentication attempted — the card is not enrolled in 3DS but an attempt was made. Partial liability shift may apply.
AI Summary: Authentication was attempted but the card is not enrolled in 3DS — a partial liability shift may still apply.

Field Definition: The outcome of the 3DS authentication request returned by the Access Control Server (ACS)
Value Definition: Challenge required — the ACS is requesting a challenge before completing authentication.
AI Summary: The issuer is requesting the cardholder completes a challenge before authentication can finish.

Field Definition: The outcome of the 3DS authentication request returned by the Access Control Server (ACS)
Value Definition: Authentication rejected — the issuer rejected the transaction and it should not be retried.
AI Summary: Authentication was rejected by the issuer — this transaction should not be retried.

Field Definition: Electronic Commerce Indicator — authentication assurance level and liability shift indicator returned by the issuer after 3DS authentication. Value meaning varies by scheme.
Value Definition: 3DS authentication was successful. Liability shift: Yes.
AI Summary: Authentication was successful on Mastercard — liability for fraud shifts to the issuer.

Field Definition: Electronic Commerce Indicator — authentication assurance level and liability shift indicator returned by the issuer after 3DS authentication. Value meaning varies by scheme.
Value Definition: 3DS authentication was processed by a stand-in service and is classed as successful. Liability shift: Yes.
AI Summary: Authentication was handled by a stand-in service on Mastercard — liability shifts to the issuer.

Field Definition: Electronic Commerce Indicator — authentication assurance level and liability shift indicator returned by the issuer after 3DS authentication. Value meaning varies by scheme.
Value Definition: 3DS authentication was successful for a recurring transaction. Liability shift: Yes (except Apple Pay without cryptogram).
AI Summary: Authentication succeeded for this recurring Mastercard transaction — liability shifts to the issuer.

Field Definition: Electronic Commerce Indicator — authentication assurance level and liability shift indicator returned by the issuer after 3DS authentication. Value meaning varies by scheme.
Value Definition: Frictionless authentication via the Mastercard Identity Check Data Only service. Liability shift: No.
AI Summary: Frictionless authentication via Mastercard Identity Check — the merchant retains liability.

Field Definition: Electronic Commerce Indicator — authentication assurance level and liability shift indicator returned by the issuer after 3DS authentication. Value meaning varies by scheme.
Value Definition: Transaction is out of scope or exempt from Strong Customer Authentication (SCA). Liability shift: No.
AI Summary: This transaction was exempt from SCA on Mastercard — the merchant retains liability.

Field Definition: Electronic Commerce Indicator — authentication assurance level and liability shift indicator returned by the issuer after 3DS authentication. Value meaning varies by scheme.
Value Definition: 3DS authentication failed or could not be attempted. Liability shift: No.
AI Summary: Authentication failed or could not be attempted on Mastercard — the merchant retains liability.

Field Definition: Electronic Commerce Indicator — authentication assurance level and liability shift indicator returned by the issuer after 3DS authentication. Value meaning varies by scheme.
Value Definition: A non-payment authentication was processed. No authorisation step. Liability shift: No.
AI Summary: This was a non-payment authentication on Mastercard — no charge was processed.

Field Definition: Electronic Commerce Indicator — authentication assurance level and liability shift indicator returned by the issuer after 3DS authentication. Value meaning varies by scheme.
Value Definition: 3DS authentication was successful. Liability shift: Yes.
AI Summary: Authentication was successful — liability for fraud shifts to the issuer.

Field Definition: Electronic Commerce Indicator — authentication assurance level and liability shift indicator returned by the issuer after 3DS authentication. Value meaning varies by scheme.
Value Definition: 3DS authentication was processed by a stand-in service and is classed as successful. Liability shift: Yes.
AI Summary: Authentication was handled by a stand-in service — liability shifts to the issuer.

Field Definition: Electronic Commerce Indicator — authentication assurance level and liability shift indicator returned by the issuer after 3DS authentication. Value meaning varies by scheme.
Value Definition: 3DS authentication used an SCA exemption or failed or could not be attempted. Liability shift: No.
AI Summary: Authentication used an exemption or was unsuccessful — the merchant retains liability.

Field Definition: Instruction sent to the issuer's ACS indicating whether a 3DS challenge is requested for this transaction
Value Definition: No preference is expressed — the ACS decides whether to apply a challenge.
AI Summary: No challenge preference was set — the issuer decided whether to challenge the cardholder.

Field Definition: Instruction sent to the issuer's ACS indicating whether a 3DS challenge is requested for this transaction
Value Definition: The merchant is requesting a challenge to be performed (e.g. for high-value or high-risk transactions).
AI Summary: The merchant requested a challenge — the cardholder was asked to actively verify their identity.

Field Definition: Instruction sent to the issuer's ACS indicating whether a 3DS challenge is requested for this transaction
Value Definition: A challenge is mandated by the merchant for regulatory or policy reasons.
AI Summary: A challenge was mandated — the cardholder was required to verify their identity by policy.

Field Definition: Instruction sent to the issuer's ACS indicating whether a 3DS challenge is requested for this transaction
Value Definition: The merchant is explicitly requesting no challenge (e.g. applying an SCA exemption).
AI Summary: The merchant requested no challenge — an exemption was applied to skip cardholder verification.

Field Definition: Indicates whether the 3DS Method (a device fingerprinting step that collects browser data before authentication) was completed
Value Definition: The 3DS Method completed successfully. Device data was collected and passed to the ACS.
AI Summary: Device data was successfully collected before authentication — this supports a stronger risk assessment.

Field Definition: Indicates whether the 3DS Method (a device fingerprinting step that collects browser data before authentication) was completed
Value Definition: The 3DS Method was not completed or was not available.
AI Summary: Device data could not be collected before authentication — the issuer had less data to assess risk.

Field Definition: Indicates whether the 3DS Method (a device fingerprinting step that collects browser data before authentication) was completed
Value Definition: The 3DS Method completion status is unknown.
AI Summary: It is unknown whether device data was collected before authentication.

Field Definition: Indicates whether the Access Control Server (ACS) required a cardholder challenge as part of 3DS authentication

Field Definition: IP address of the customer's device at the time of payment (masked)

Field Definition: IP address of the device used to initiate the payment as captured by the fraud engine (masked)
AI Summary: The IP address captured by the fraud engine — masked for security. May differ from the checkout IP if a proxy or VPN was used.

Field Definition: Machine learning-generated score (0–100) indicating the probability that the transaction is fraudulent
Value Definition: Low risk. The transaction shows minimal fraud signals.
AI Summary: This payment has a low risk score — the fraud engine considers it unlikely to be fraudulent.

Field Definition: Machine learning-generated score (0–100) indicating the probability that the transaction is fraudulent
Value Definition: Medium risk. The transaction shows moderate fraud signals and may warrant additional review.
AI Summary: This payment has a medium risk score — some fraud signals are present and it may warrant review.

Field Definition: Machine learning-generated score (0–100) indicating the probability that the transaction is fraudulent
Value Definition: High risk. The transaction shows strong fraud signals and may be declined or flagged.
AI Summary: This payment has a high risk score — strong fraud signals were detected and it may have been blocked.

Field Definition: Contribution of device behaviour signals to the overall risk score. Shown as positive (increases risk) or negative (decreases risk).
Value Definition: Device behaviour signals (e.g. unusual device or unfamiliar browser) are increasing the risk score.
AI Summary: The device used for this payment looks unfamiliar or unusual — this is raising the risk score.

Field Definition: Contribution of device behaviour signals to the overall risk score. Shown as positive (increases risk) or negative (decreases risk).
Value Definition: Device behaviour signals are reducing the risk score — the device appears legitimate and familiar.
AI Summary: The device used looks legitimate and familiar — this is lowering the risk score.

Field Definition: Contribution of card usage patterns to the overall risk score
Value Definition: Card usage patterns (e.g. high velocity or unusual spend behaviour) are increasing the risk score.
AI Summary: This card's recent activity looks unusual — for example high transaction velocity — which is raising the risk score.

Field Definition: Contribution of card usage patterns to the overall risk score
Value Definition: Card usage patterns are reducing the risk score — the card shows normal activity.
AI Summary: This card's recent activity looks normal — this is lowering the risk score.

Field Definition: Contribution of historical fraud signals associated with this card or customer to the risk score
Value Definition: The card or customer has prior fraud signals on record that are increasing the risk score.
AI Summary: Prior fraud signals have been detected for this card or customer — this is raising the risk score.

Field Definition: Contribution of historical fraud signals associated with this card or customer to the risk score
